create_prisma_wrapper: create a PrismaWrapper instance to handle RDS IAM token authentication for the Prisma client
start_token_refresh_loop: start the background RDS IAM token proactive refresh loop that renews tokens before expiration
refresh_prisma_client: recreate the Prisma client by disconnecting and reconnecting with a new database URL
setup_database: run prisma db push or prisma migrate to set up the LiteLLM database schema
check_prisma_schema_updates: check whether Prisma schema updates should be applied during startup based on DISABLE_SCHEMA_UPDATE
